summary.headline: Conjunctions and Lunar Phases
summary.text: Astrological rules for conjunctions and aspects, including application, planetary light, one-sign limits, and judgments involving combust planets, with authorities such as Tusi, Masha'allah, Abu Ma'shar, and Bayhaqi. Chapter Four then defines conjunctions and oppositions of the Sun and Moon, their Arabic and Persian names, and lunar phases near the solar square.
